environment.description: Stream processor deployed as ECS Fargate task in private subnet (no IGW route, no NAT for inbound). The admin HTTP interface (port 8080) is fronted by an internal NLB whose target group is registered via AWS PrivateLink as a VPC Endpoint Service (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890). Consumer applications must create an Interface VPC Endpoint in their own VPC to reach the service. The endpoint service has 'Acceptance Required' enabled (manual approval of each connecting account). The endpoint policy attached to the VPC Endpoint restricts access to principals matching arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/authorized-caller-* only. Additionally, the NLB listener has no public DNS and the Fargate task's security group only permits inbound from the NLB's ENI security group on port 8080. There is no internet-facing path to the container.

config.deployment: ECS Fargate in private subnet (no IGW, no public IP)
